overview.description: The Federated Hermes MDT Large Cap Growth ETF (FLCG) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in large cap equity. The fund is actively managed, investing primarily in large-cap US companies with higher forecasted growth values that are within the Russell 1000 Growth Index. The fund aims for capital growth, utilizing a quantitative model focused on maximizing returns and risk management FLCG was launched on Jul 30, 2024 and is issued by Federated Hermes.
